clue.text: No wine to be taken into flat — it's a sacred place

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside another, as the wine is taken into the flat

parts.note: flat, as in dull or lifeless, means tame
red is a type of wine

explanation.surface: A temperance rule bars wine from a bare flat, explaining it is holy ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flat' looks like an apartment holding the wine; here it means dull, tame.
explanation.definitionFit: The Paris cathedral is a famous Christian church, a sacred place of worship.

clue.text: Name conductor in French region

parts.note: Eugene Ormandy was a conductor, long with the Philadelphia Orchestra

explanation.surface: Name a conductor in a French region.
explanation.definitionFit: Normandy is a region in northern France.

clue.text: A bulb can be extremely useful in propped-up mine

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other
in a down clue, propped up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a pit is a mine

indicators.note: extremely points to the extreme letters of the word, first and last

explanation.surface: A bulb could be very handy down a propped-up mine shaft.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'propped-up' means the mine is read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A tulip grows from a bulb, so the plant is named by its bulb.

clue.text: English university with typical irregular trees

indicators.note: irregular shows the letters are not in their usual order

explanation.surface: An English university's typical trees, oddly arranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Eucalypti, the gum trees, is a plural of eucalyptus.

clue.text: Evergreen delivered by singer, half cut, gatecrashing a party

indicators.note: a gatecrasher gets inside a party, so one piece enters the other

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: half the word is cut off, so its last four letters go

parts.note: a vocalist is a singer

explanation.surface: A tipsy singer crashes a party and delivers an evergreen song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half cut' also suggests tipsy, and 'Evergreen' suggests a song; the tree is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: The avocado tree is evergreen, keeping its leaves all year.

clue.text: Advocate has qualified at last in English Language

indicators.note: the letter goes in the language

parts.note: Norse is a language

indicators.note: at last points to the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A qualified advocate of the English language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts D, the last letter of 'qualified', inside NORSE.
explanation.definitionFit: To advocate a policy is to endorse it, giving public support.

clue.text: Prohibit almost everything in flat

parts.note: to prohibit is to ban

indicators.note: almost the whole word, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: everything means all

explanation.surface: A ban on almost everything inside an apartment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the final L of ALL, leaving AL. 'flat' wants to be an apartment; it is the dull adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Something banal is commonplace and dull, just as a flat remark lacks interest.

clue.text: Runs into singer making money

indicators.note: one piece runs into the other

parts.note: a bass is a low-voiced singer
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A singer gets into the money.
explanation.definitionFit: Brass is informal British slang for money.

clue.text: Infamous film noir, too, involved America

indicators.note: involved, as in convoluted, means the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: An infamous film noir, also involving America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' rearranges NOIR TOO into NOTORIO. 'film' is padding for the surface: Notorious is also a Hitchcock film.
explanation.definitionFit: Notorious and infamous both mean well known for something bad.

clue.text: Food store, authentic, put up across the road

indicators.note: one piece lies across the other, so it surrounds it
in a down clue, put up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: authentic means real
RD is the abbreviation for road

explanation.surface: A genuine food store is set up across the road.
explanation.definitionFit: A larder is a cool room or cupboard for storing food.

clue.text: Roman Catholic priest's inside exhibiting object of historic interest

indicators.note: the priest is inside, so his name sits within the other letters

parts.note: Eli is the priest in the Old Testament who raised Samuel

explanation.surface: A Catholic priest's interior holds something historically interesting.
explanation.walkthrough: Eli is a crossword regular for 'priest'.
explanation.definitionFit: A relic is a surviving item from the past, valued for its historical associations.

clue.text: Early teacher, great artist

definitions.meaning: a schoolmaster from the old days, read literally
the term for a leading European painter before about 1800

explanation.definitionFit: Read literally the phrase is a teacher of old; as a set term it names a renowned pre-1800 painter.

clue.text: A graduate has drink in flask

indicators.note: the graduate has the drink within, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate
a pull is a swig or drink, as from a bottle

explanation.surface: A graduate takes a swig from a hip flask.
explanation.walkthrough: A pull is a long swallow from a glass or bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: An ampulla is a small round flask, as used for holy oil in antiquity.

clue.text: Hold back a substitute

definitions.meaning: to keep something back for later use
a player kept on the bench to come on

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means keep for later; as a noun it is a stand-in player.

clue.text: What safeguard at accountants affords?

parts.note: a firm of accountants holds clients' figures, and a safeguard there would shield that information; the legal term for such safeguards

explanation.surface: Wondering what security an accountancy firm provides.
explanation.definitionFit: The legal term for safeguarding personal information held by organisations.

clue.text: Jupiter, the king seen about below?

indicators.note: the word goes about, round, the other piece

parts.note: taken as written
below means under
R is the abbreviation for king, from the Latin rex

explanation.surface: Jupiter, the king of the gods, is seen around the underworld.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen' is a link; 'The Thunderer' is also an old nickname of The Times.
explanation.definitionFit: Jupiter, the Roman sky god armed with thunderbolts, bore the epithet Tonans, the one who thunders.

clue.text: Gypsy in rep

definitions.meaning: a person of a nomadic people
a sales representative travelling to clients

explanation.definitionFit: The word means one of the travelling people, and also a commercial travelling salesman.

clue.text: One who judges animals, tailless kind

parts.note: asses are animals

indicators.note: the tail, the last letter, is removed

parts.note: a kind is a sort

explanation.surface: A judge of animals is himself a tailless sort.
explanation.definitionFit: An assessor judges value or quality, as for tax or insurance.

clue.text: Instrument used by Annie, perhaps, fronting good girls

indicators.note: the first piece stands in front of the rest

parts.note: Annie is a stage musical, so it is an example of one
lasses are girls

explanation.surface: Little Annie plays an instrument in front of nice girls.
explanation.walkthrough: Annie is the Broadway musical about an orphan, not a person here.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuned glasses rubbed with wet fingers form a real instrument, the glass harmonica's ancestor.

clue.text: Run off with sailor, back out East

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor

indicators.note: the letter is put out of the word

parts.note: to back a motion is to second it

explanation.surface: Run away with a sailor, heading back out East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' drops E from SECOND, leaving SCOND. 'back' is not a reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To abscond is to run off secretly, often with something.

clue.text: Cowardly? That's conjecture about rising lieutenant

indicators.note: the conjecture goes about, round, the other piece

parts.note: a conjecture is a guess

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means read upwards

explanation.surface: Speculation that a promoted lieutenant is cowardly.
explanation.definitionFit: Gutless means lacking guts, that is courage.

clue.text: Shame I bent an old golf club

indicators.note: bent means out of shape, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: Ashamed, I bent an old golf club.
explanation.definitionFit: A mashie was an old iron golf club, roughly a five iron.

clue.text: Plug ceremonial clothing in speech

parts.note: a plug is an advertisement, or ad
dress, as in full dress, is formal clothing

explanation.surface: A promotional plug for formal wear given during a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: An address is a formal speech delivered to an audience.

clue.text: Composition in English on Senegal's capital, for example

indicators.note: a capital is the head letter, so the first letter is taken

parts.note: say means for example

explanation.surface: A composition in English on Senegal's capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts E above the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: An essay is a short written composition.

clue.text: Unchanged, thesis about South Africa

indicators.note: the thesis goes round the other piece

parts.note: a thesis is a proposition or theme

explanation.surface: A thesis on South Africa that has not been revised.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that stays the same has not altered at all.

clue.text: Extreme suffering since New York's gone under

indicators.note: the second piece goes under the first in a down clue

parts.note: since, as in long since, means ago
NY is the abbreviation for New York

explanation.surface: Great pain since New York sank.
explanation.definitionFit: Agony is extreme physical or mental suffering.

clue.text: Such a forecast may involve one's own house

definitions.text: Such a forecast may involve one's own house

parts.words: Such a forecast may involve one's own house
parts.note: astrologers divide the sky into twelve houses, so a star-based prediction may speak of one's house, not one's home

explanation.surface: A prediction about one's home.
explanation.definitionFit: An astrological forecast is cast from planets' positions in the twelve houses.

clue.text: Famous caterer in French city

definitions.meaning: J. ... was a British catering firm famous for its tea shops
the English spelling of the city of Lyon

explanation.definitionFit: J. Lyons ran British tea shops; the name is also the English spelling of a big French city.

clue.text: Forward almost losing face

indicators.note: the face is the front, so the first letter goes

parts.note: almost means nearly

explanation.surface: A forward player nearly loses face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing face' drops N, the first letter of NEARLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Early and forward both mean ahead of the usual time, as in a forward spring.

clue.text: See dry rot's affected ship

indicators.note: the words are affected, so changed into a new arrangement

parts.note: the possessive adds no letter

explanation.surface: Inspect the dry rot that has damaged a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A destroyer is a fast warship.
